2 really important concepts that I've picked up reading thru various journals of Master traders

1) After engulf, price is free to move to origin of EG in that TF 2) Price likes to go 'coast-to-coast'

So the implication is, if there's an engulf of a H1 level, price is free to move back to the origin of that EG in the H1 TF or the FTR of that DP. Which means don't diddle in the middle of that TF when price hasn't reached its objective yet unless there's another EG which takes precedence

Here's a setup while I slept RT to MPL of Sweet Pedini FTR. Took a conservative TG for 5R

OK, this is one setup to pin up on the wall and look at EVERY day to ingrain the important aspects of RTM: 1) Trick Played in past creates a nice MPL 2) price approaches the MPL but backs off and engulfs the FTR. So FOF says price wants higher to MPL 3) price hits MPL, SL == 8-10 pips 4) TG1 = 5R, TG2 = 10R, TG3 = 15R

It's great to see it all sinking in so well so quickly! Well done you
